external_deps: An AI coding agent host (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.)

review.tagline: Plugin of 36 agent skills for a plan, build, review and document loop
review.summary: Compound Engineering is a plugin of 36 skills for AI coding agents, organized around a loop of brainstorm, plan, work, simplify, review and compound. The compound step writes learnings into docs/solutions/, which later brainstorm and plan runs read as context. It installs on 14 agent hosts, including Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and includes an autonomous /lfg pipeline that can open a PR and watch CI.
review.audience: Developers using AI coding agents who want a structured, documented workflow
strengths: Runs on 14 agent hosts, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and OpenCode
Captures learnings as repo files (docs/solutions/) that later planning reads
Covers the full cycle: brainstorm, plan, work, review, plus debug, commit and PR skills
Artifact folder location is configurable via the docs_root setting
weaknesses: 36 skills and a multi-step workflow add process overhead for small changes
Install steps differ per host; Cline and Pi need extra setup or companion packages
Compound Packs for org-wide rules are marked experimental
Some Devin skills use Claude-style tool names and prompt for permission
needs: Needs An AI coding agent host (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.), pi-subagents (Pi only)
